I’m attaching a short regional-demo-agenda.pdf with proposed topics and an ics stub. If you prefer we can also do one live session and record for APAC with a follow-up office-hours slot timed for Singapore.

We’ve accounted for that in the schedule below so no one gets the surprise.

Confirmed plan (I’ll send invites now):
- Tue Mar 15, 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — Americas + engineering (60 min) — joins: Rishi + Steph
- Wed Mar 16, 15:30 GMT / 16:30 CET — EMEA + product (60 min) — Steph will lead
- Wed Mar 16, 23:00 SGT — APAC office hours (30 min) — recording available for those who cannot make live

If anyone prefers a single recorded session + guaranteed live APAC office hours instead of three slots, say so and I’ll rebook.

Agenda attached; invites include explicit timezone labels and an ics file.

See you next week — feel free to add items to the agenda doc.
